a.title: Open the diagram of 4 Build the task into a PR

rect.style: cursor: pointer

a.text: ↑ Called by "4-6 Build every open task" in A feature from request to main

g.text: Agent: its lane, its steps and the flows they start
Review agent: its lane, its steps and the flows they start
Owner: its lane, its steps and the flows they start
GitHub: its lane, its steps and the flows they start
thick border: a step drawn in its own diagram; click it to open that diagram
person icon: a step done by hand
gear icon: a step a machine runs
small arrow on a line: the way it runs; the big one is where it ends
diamond: one answer is taken; a loop returns through an unnamed one
